reviews.text: Dr Owens and Brian were beyond words!
Recommended.  Professional, knowledgeable, care and loving. Great service.

I’ve been with Dr. Johnson for over 20 years, and I truly can’t recommend her highly enough. She has cared for my dogs since they were born, and thanks to her dedication and expertise, they’ve lived long, healthy lives—up to 19 years.
Dr. Johnson is incredibly compassionate, knowledgeable, and highly trained, having graduated from the University of Pennsylvania—one of the top veterinary schools in the country. She consistently goes above and beyond what you’d expect from a veterinarian.
What really sets her apart is her availability and commitment. She has always been there when I needed her, even after hours, showing a level of care and dedication that is rare to find.
If you’re looking for a vet who truly cares about your pets as much as you do, Dr. Johnson is the one.

Ron G

Royal Vet is second to none.  The care, the expertise, the knowledge, the love they give to the pets is indescribable.  Dr Johnson, Dr Owen are SUPER.  I love Royal Vet. I don’t know what I would do without them.  They have prolonged my 15 year old chihuahua’s life through their care and their referral to amazing specialists. I can go on & on but really should stop ❤️❤️❤️❤️
